goal: P3: identify exact stationary conditional operators, nonclosing function families, aging/support obstacles and explicit physical-query error obligations before another representation fit

stationary_partition.meaning: Conditioning arguments, not plug-in estimates or frozen nuisance truth. The original sixteen-dimensional uncertainty/prior/support remains authoritative.
stationary_partition.likelihood: One quadratic in nine alpha coordinates at each eta; a 55-coefficient FUNCTION FIELD over eta, not 55 globally constant coefficients
stationary_partition.normalizer: Retain n*log(sigma*sqrt(2*pi)); sigma=0.001 V in the inherited fixture
stationary_partition.support: Use original support and all-prefix physical legality; B is constrained by abs(B)<=H, with a collapsed boundary at H=0. No division by H is needed for original-chart likelihood queries.

aging.inherited_implemented_model: Per-record bounded normalized Q/R0 transitions, SOC-continuous capacity availability, deterministic fast state conditional on the complete health path
aging.RC_extension: User-confirmed C_i=tau_i/R_i. Voltage-continuous and branch-charge-continuous boundary maps are derived as separate assumptions; neither is selected or calibrated here.
aging.proposed_envelopes: 0.5–1.5 relative changes, likely0.7–1.3, remain design assumptions; not rate bounds, certified support or coverage
no_hidden_changes: No replacement of bounded kernels by unbounded Gaussian diffusion
No assumption that equal end health implies equal history

error_scope: Approximation of the same admitted likelihood on common exact support; transition/map errors and prior/chart changes are separate. No numeric compression budget is inferred from SOC/Q point targets.
nonclaims: All exact history compression is impossible
A fixed additive likelihood basis can exactly represent arbitrary continuous-rate/charge histories
The conditional amplitude square root is a marginal posterior
M23 memory or ten-year numerical accuracy is established
